annotations.title: Run or record risk of bias

description: Use this when the researcher wants AI risk-of-bias drafts (action run; dry_run defaults to true), a study's instrument changed (action set_tool, e.g. robins_e for exposures, nos for cohort or case-control, nos_cs for cross-sectional; RoB 2 only fits randomized trials) or a judgement recorded (action decide: the instrument and the per-domain judgements the researcher states, never your own; logged as from this chat). The suggested instrument ignores each study's design: on an instrument check, agree it with the researcher before drafting. Drafting is paid and needs the extraction stage approved.

domains.description: decide: the researcher's judgement per domain.

dry_run.description: Default true: only report what would run and the quota used. false launches.

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the first launch instead of a second job.
